aeroagentsim.workflow.logistics.LogisticsWorkflow¶

class aeroagentsim.workflow.logistics.LogisticsWorkflow(env, name, owner, timeout=None, event_names=[], initial_status='idle', callback=None, properties=None)[source]¶

物流工作流，管理无人机取件、运输和交付货物的过程。

工作流状态流转： picking_up -> transporting -> delivering -> completed
